requirement_vague: Verify user deletion fails when user has articles (FK constraint, no cascade delete)

omissions.description: No user deletion endpoint exists for DELETE /api/users/{email}, so the required deletion attempt and resulting FK-constraint failure behavior cannot occur.
omissions.reasoning: The code defines POST /api/users, POST /api/users/login, GET/PUT /api/user, profile follow routes, and article/comment routes, but there is no DELETE route under /api/users or any route that deletes a user by email.
